'''Stevus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[biochemist]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Stevus managed a small shop, also teaching the knowledge of biochemistry to others.
